comparison_to_sealed_original_R18_order_.interpretation: The preregistered graph-derived cutset-first symbolic order did not improve completion under the same frozen 120-second R18 envelope and incurred more observed symbolic work before OPEN. Therefore R24/R24B width-band entry is not sufficient evidence that placing those eight variables first is a better Shannon elimination schedule.

scientific_update: The transferable R24/R24B graph-only cutset signal does not translate automatically into a cheaper Shannon existential schedule. R25 preserves this as a failed scheduling hypothesis without reading W05 semantic truth. The correct next experiment is a finite pre-frozen structure-only family of Shannon existential orders, with the original R18 order and R25 cutset-first order as controls, rather than post-hoc tuning of the eight-variable prefix.
